basic_details.job_title: GBPNIHE Research Associate II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment has invited applications from Indian citizens for one temporary Research Associate-II position under the NMHS funded project "Creation of an Integrated Database of the Himalayan Biodiversity for Mainstreaming in Policy to meet National Commitments". Eligible candidates must submit their applications through the online recruitment portal at gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php on or before 11:59 PM on 06th November, 2026.

content_sections.heading: About GBPNIHE Research Associate-II Recruitment
content_sections.text: The G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment, located at Kosi-Katarmal, Almora, Uttarakhand, operates as an autonomous institution dedicated to the protection and sustainable management of Himalayan ecosystems. This recruitment is conducted for a temporary project-based position to evaluate ecosystem services following the SEEA framework and perform spatial data analytics.

rows.essential_qualification: Doctoral Degree in Biological Sciences, Environmental Science and Development, Geography, Ecology, Botany or allied subjects from a recognized University AND One year of Research experience in the relevant field.
rows.desirable: Experience and Expertise in RS&GIS Evidence of scientific research as paper/dissertation.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated emolument of Rs 61000 per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA). The engagement is purely temporary in nature under the NMHS funded project.

content_sections.heading: GBPNIHE Research Associate-II Job Description
content_sections.text: Evaluation of field and remote sensing-based Ecosystem Services of various ecosystems following SEEA framework. Extraction of various climatic, edaphic, ecological and social factors and delineation of ecosystems for modeling through RS&GIS and data analytics. Other related work including field data collection.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GBPNIHE Research Associate-II
content_sections.text: Visit the online recruitment portal at gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php. Complete the online application form with required personal and academic details. Ensure submission before 11:59 PM on 06th November, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Short-listed candidates will be informed separately about the mode of interview, date, and time. Candidates appearing for the interview physically must bring original documents pertaining to their educational qualifications and experience along with one set of photocopies.
